nodes.description: Constant WETH wrapper address used by isWETH and by the ETH/WETH handling helpers of AtomicUtils.
Hardcoded AtomicBlue executor address to which the proxy forwards every swap request.
Internal helper returning this contract's ETH or ERC20 balance for a given token.
Internal helper that pushes ETH (recipient.send) or ERC20 tokens (token.transfer) to a payable recipient.
Internal helper pulling the trade input from msg.sender via transferFrom (or requiring msg.value for ETH).
Internal ERC20 approval helper tolerant of non-compliant tokens.
Assembly helper that interprets optional ERC20 return data of token calls.
Predicate treating address(0) and the EEE sentinel address as ETH.
Memory-safe bytes slicing helper using assembly; bounds check uses an unchecked addition.
Public payable entrypoint of the executor: runs a distributed swap, enforces minOutput, pays the recipient and emits Trade.
Public payable entrypoint performing a chained multi-hop distributed swap and paying the recipient.
Internal core engine that splits the input across exchange chunks, performs arbitrary calls or delegatecalls and returns the buy-token balance.
Public payable wrapper calling swapAndSend with msg.sender as recipient.
Public payable wrapper calling multiPathSwapAndSend with msg.sender as recipient.
Fallback receive function allowing plain ETH transfers into the executor.
Proxy entrypoint: claims seller tokens from msg.sender to the executor, then forwards the call with value.
Proxy entrypoint for multi-path swaps; claims input tokens and forwards to AtomicBlue.
Proxy wrapper calling swapAndSend with msg.sender as recipient.
Proxy swap that also burns gas tokens based on measured gas consumption.
Proxy wrapper calling multiPathSwapAndSend with msg.sender as recipient.
Multi-path proxy swap that afterwards burns gas tokens for the caller.
Swap-and-send proxy entrypoint that additionally burns gas tokens for msg.sender.
Multi-path swap-and-send proxy entrypoint with post-swap gas token burning.
Untrusted caller address; supplies trade input, is the default recipient and is recorded in the Trade event.
address(target).call.value(value)(callData) with attacker-controlled target and calldata inside doDistributedSwap.
delegatecall to a caller-supplied exchange module, executing untrusted code in the executor's storage context.
External ERC20 transferFrom(msg.sender, _receiver, _amount) executed on an arbitrary token contract.
recipient.send(amount) forwarding ETH to an arbitrary address with a fixed 2300 gas stipend.
External call to a caller-supplied gas token contract (freeFromUpTo).
Unchecked arithmetic _swap.input * chunks[i] / totalChunks used to split the trade input.
Unchecked arithmetic (startGas - gasleft() + 25000) / _gasQtyPerToken used to size the gas token burn.
Unchecked addition _start + _length in the sliceBytes bounds check can overflow.
SwapParams memory _swap parameter of AtomicBlue.swapAndSend describing sell/buy tokens, input and minOutput.
DistributionParams memory _distribution parameter holding exchange modules, calldata and chunk weights.
address payable _receipient parameter that receives the swap output.
Token[] calldata _path parameter listing the swap route hops.
IGasToken _gasToken parameter of the gas-token burning proxy entries.
uint _gasQtyPerToken parameter used as the divisor when computing how many gas tokens to burn.
Accumulator local of the per-exchange chunk counts in doDistributedSwap.
Per-module input amount derived from _swap.input and the chunk weights.
Return local holding the executor's output amount in AtomicTokenProxy.swapAndSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is recorded as the indexed trader in the Trade event and used as the default recipient.
Proxy pulls the trade input from msg.sender before forwarding to the executor.
transferFrom(_from = msg.sender, _receiver, _amount) moves caller tokens.
Gas tokens are burned from msg.sender's balance.
_swap is forwarded into the distributed swap engine.
_distribution drives module selection, calldata and chunk weights.
_receipient is passed to send() as the output destination.
_path determines the sell/buy token pair of every hop passed to doDistributedSwap.
_gasToken is the target of the freeFromUpTo external call.
_gasQtyPerToken is the divisor in the gas accounting expression.
totalChunks is used as the divisor when splitting the input across modules.
thisInput is computed from the unchecked _swap.input * chunks[i] / totalChunks product.
The swap output local is returned to the caller and forwarded to the recipient.
swapAndSend delegates execution to doDistributedSwap.
multiPathSwapAndSend calls doDistributedSwap once per path hop.
After the slippage check swapAndSend calls send() to pay the recipient.
ETH output is pushed to an arbitrary recipient via the low-level send helper.
send() executes recipient.send(amount) which transfers control to the recipient.
doDistributedSwap performs an arbitrary low-level call to a caller-supplied target and calldata.
doDistributedSwap delegatecalls a caller-supplied exchange module.
The callee can reenter swapAndSend before the output balance is settled and sent.
Delegatecalled module code keeps state access and can reenter the executor entrypoint.
Malicious module code can reenter the proxy entrypoint while tokens are already claimed.
Chunk splitting arithmetic is performed inside doDistributedSwap without overflow protection.
claimTokenFromSenderTo performs an external ERC20 transferFrom call.
A malicious token could reenter the proxy swap flow during transferFrom.
Proxy first claims the seller tokens from the caller before swapping.
Proxy forwards the swap request (with value) to the AtomicBlue executor.
Multi-path proxy entrypoint claims the input tokens from the caller first.
Multi-path proxy entrypoint forwards execution to AtomicBlue.multiPathSwapAndSend.
swapWithGasTokens invokes the internal swapAndSend before burning gas tokens.
Gas usage computation can underflow and can divide by a caller-controlled _gasQtyPerToken.
After the swap the function calls freeFromUpTo on the supplied gas token.
sliceBytes validates _start + _length in an unchecked addition.
doDistributedSwap reads balanceOf(buyToken) to determine the produced output.

normalization_plan.reason: _swap is a parameter only meaningful inside AtomicBlue.swapAndSend and should be modelled as part of that function node.
_distribution is a parameter consumed only by the swapAndSend entrypoint.
_receipient is a parameter whose value is only used by the send() call inside swapAndSend.
_path is a parameter used only by multiPathSwapAndSend to build the hop sequence.
_gasToken is a parameter used only by the gas-token burning wrapper functions.
_gasQtyPerToken is a parameter used only as the divisor in the gas accounting of the wrapper.
totalChunks is a local accumulator that exists only inside doDistributedSwap.
thisInput is a local computed per iteration inside doDistributedSwap.
_output is a local return value that only lives inside AtomicTokenProxy.swapAndSend.
